**Written to `HANDOFF.md`.** Roll back `dep-4471`, the gateway config by `a.novak`.

It set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. Each request then grabbed its own connection from a pool of 20. Impact ran 02:14:18 to 03:59:27 UTC and was still going. That is 530 failures out of 636 requests, 83%.

Heads up: this log is node 3 of 3, so two nodes are unchecked.
